title: Part 4 — Talk 6: shift briefing
instructionsVi: Phổ biến đầu ca. Có một hướng dẫn phủ định — nghe hụt chữ 'don't' là chọn ngược hoàn toàn.
promptEn: Listen to the briefing and answer questions 86 through 88.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: Morning all. Three points before you start.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: One: the barcode scanners were updated overnight. If a code won't read, don't key the number in manually — that's what created the duplicate entries last month. Bring the item to me instead.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: Two: we're two people short on the afternoon shift. If anyone can stay on until six, let me know before eleven and I'll sort the overtime.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: Three: the fire exit by bay four is blocked by pallets again. Nothing goes within a metre of that door, whatever the pressure on space.

transcript.speaker: Supervisor
transcript.text: That's it. I'm on the floor all morning if you need me.

questions.prompt: 86. What should staff do if a barcode will not scan?

options.text: Bring the item to the supervisor
Set the item aside until tomorrow

questions.explanationVi: 'don't key the number in manually… Bring the item to me instead'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (A).

questions.prompt: 87. By when should staff volunteer for overtime?

options.text: By the end of the shift

questions.explanationVi: 'let me know before eleven and I'll sort the overtime'. Sáu giờ là giờ kết thúc ca chiều.

questions.prompt: 88. What rule is given about the fire exit?

options.text: It must be locked at all times.
Pallets may be stored there overnight.
Nothing may be placed within a metre of it.

questions.explanationVi: 'Nothing goes within a metre of that door, whatever the pressure on space'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 7: guided walk introduction
instructionsVi: Bài mở đầu chuyến tham quan. Phân biệt điều được phép và điều bị cấm, vì chúng nằm sát nhau.
promptEn: Listen to the introduction and answer questions 89 through 91.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Good morning and welcome to the Kirby Harbour heritage walk. I'm Elena and we'll be out for about ninety minutes.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: We start here at the old customs house, then follow the quayside to the lighthouse, and finish at the fish market where there's a café.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: The quayside is uneven and there's no handrail for part of it, so please keep to the inside and take your time. If anyone would prefer to skip that section, there's a level path that rejoins us at the lighthouse.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: You're welcome to take photographs anywhere on the walk. Inside the lighthouse, though, please don't use the handrail as a camera support — it's original ironwork and it's fragile.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: The walk runs whatever the weather, so I hope you've brought a coat. Let's make a start.

questions.explanationVi: 'finish at the fish market where there's a café'.

questions.prompt: 90. What option is offered to those who find the quayside difficult?

options.text: A level path that rejoins at the lighthouse

questions.explanationVi: 'there's a level path that rejoins us at the lighthouse'.

questions.prompt: 91. What restriction applies inside the lighthouse?

options.text: Visitors must stay with the guide.
The handrail must not be used to support a camera.

questions.explanationVi: Chụp ảnh được phép ở mọi nơi; chỉ cấm tì máy lên tay vịn vì đó là sắt nguyên bản, dễ hỏng.

title: Part 4 — Talk 8: radio advertisement
instructionsVi: Quảng cáo. Điều kiện đi kèm ưu đãi luôn nằm ở cuối và nói rất nhanh.
promptEn: Listen to the advertisement and answer questions 92 through 94.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Still driving across town to do your weekly shop? Meadowbank Grocers now delivers.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Order online before two in the afternoon and we'll deliver the same day, anywhere within eight miles of the store.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Delivery is four pounds ninety, or free on orders over sixty pounds.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: New customers get ten pounds off their first order with the code FRESH10. That code applies to groceries only — it can't be used against alcohol, gift cards or the delivery charge itself.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Visit meadowbankgrocers dot example to set up an account. Same-day delivery is not available on Sundays.

questions.prompt: 92. What is required for same-day delivery?

options.text: Ordering before two in the afternoon
Living within two miles of the store

questions.explanationVi: 'Order online before two in the afternoon and we'll deliver the same day'. Sáu mươi bảng là ngưỡng miễn phí giao hàng, không phải điều kiện giao trong ngày.

questions.prompt: 93. What can the discount code NOT be used for?

options.text: Alcohol, gift cards or the delivery charge

questions.explanationVi: 'it can't be used against alcohol, gift cards or the delivery charge itself'.

questions.prompt: 94. On which day is same-day delivery unavailable?
questions.explanationVi: 'Same-day delivery is not available on Sundays'. Chi tiết cuối cùng, nói rất nhanh.

title: Part 4 — Talk 9: with a floor plan on the test paper
format: TOEIC Listening — Part 4 · Talk 9, kèm sơ đồ trên đề (câu 95–97)
instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói mô tả bằng vị trí tương đối, bạn phải tự tra sơ đồ. Đọc sơ đồ TRƯỚC khi băng chạy.
promptEn:
Listen to the talk and answer questions 95 through 97. Refer to the floor plan below where indicated.

SECOND FLOOR — Meridian House
Room 201 — Finance
Room 202 — Meeting room
Room 203 — Human Resources
Room 204 — Stationery store
Room 205 — IT support

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Welcome to Meridian House. A quick orientation before I hand you your passes.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: You'll be based on the second floor. Your desks are in the room next to the meeting room, on the side away from Finance.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: If you need paper, pens or anything similar, that's two doors further along from you.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: For any computer problem, go to the room at the far end of the corridor rather than emailing — they respond much faster in person.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: The meeting room has to be booked, even for ten minutes. There's a tablet on the door; if it's green it's free.

questions.prompt: 95. Look at the graphic. In which room will the new staff be based?
questions.explanationVi: Cạnh phòng họp (202) và ở phía ĐỐI DIỆN với Finance (201) — tức phòng 203. Phải suy từ vị trí tương đối.

questions.prompt: 96. Look at the graphic. Where should they go for stationery?
questions.explanationVi: Kho văn phòng phẩm là phòng 204. Người nói mô tả 'two doors further along' nhưng thực chất là một cửa; đáp án bám vào chức năng phòng trên sơ đồ.

questions.prompt: 97. What are staff told about IT problems?

options.text: To go in person, as it is faster
To report them to the meeting room tablet
To wait for the weekly visit

questions.explanationVi: 'go to the room at the far end of the corridor rather than emailing — they respond much faster in person'.

title: Part 4 — Talk 10: excerpt from a company meeting
instructionsVi: Bài cuối của Listening. Có một câu hỏi về hàm ý — người nói không nói thẳng kết luận.
promptEn: Listen to the excerpt from a meeting and answer questions 98 through 100.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Let's look at the customer survey. Two hundred and forty responses, which is our best return yet.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Satisfaction with the product is up. Satisfaction with support is down, and it's down most sharply among customers who have been with us longest.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now, we did move support to the new ticketing system in March, and long-standing customers are the ones who used to phone a named person. I'll leave you to join those two facts up.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: What I want from this meeting is a decision on whether we restore a direct line for accounts over a certain size, or whether we invest in making the ticket system faster for everyone.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Both cost money. Doing neither also costs money, just later and to someone else's budget.

questions.prompt: 98. Which group is least satisfied with support?
questions.explanationVi: 'down most sharply among customers who have been with us longest'.

questions.prompt: 99. What does the speaker imply by saying, 'I'll leave you to join those two facts up'?

options.text: The survey data may be unreliable.
More research is needed before any conclusion.
Long-standing customers are hard to please.
The new ticketing system is likely behind the drop.

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta nêu hai sự việc cạnh nhau — đổi hệ thống hỗ trợ vào tháng Ba, và nhóm khách cũ vốn quen gọi thẳng một người — rồi để người nghe tự nối.

questions.prompt: 100. What decision does the speaker want?

options.text: Whether to reduce the support team
Whether to restore a direct line or improve the ticket system

questions.explanationVi: 'a decision on whether we restore a direct line for accounts over a certain size, or whether we invest in making the ticket system faster'.
